long_biography.plain_text:
Christopher “Chris” Kool Jr. comes from the third generation of the family behind Vermeer Midwest. His grandparents, Junior and Beverly Kool, founded the equipment dealership in Illinois in 1971; it later expanded across four Midwestern states while remaining family-owned. From Defiance, Missouri, Kool played offensive tackle at Elmhurst College, earning varsity letters and starting five games on the offensive line.

Kool has also become a direct investor in Florida apartment property. A Tampa capital-markets report identified him as the buyer in a 38-unit transaction, while Florida records name him as manager of a real-estate holding company. That company acquired Arbor Glade, an apartment community in Ocala, in 2025, adding a documented operating asset to his investment record.
